description: Move the owner's USDC from another chain into this account's verified Arc home Safe through Circle Gateway, in one resumable owner-signed call. Felix tops up only the shortfall in the owner's Gateway balance: the owner broadcasts that approval and Gateway deposit through your own FELIX_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL (owner-paid source gas), signs the burn intent, and signs the Arc mint SafeTx; Felix pays the Arc mint gas. A direct Arc deposit needs no call: send Arc USDC only to the verified arc.address from get_deposit_address. Not live-certified on this release.

amount_usd.description: USDC to credit into the Arc home Safe, at most six decimals.

idempotency_key.description: Required durable workflow key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

max_fee_usd.description: Owner-paid Circle Gateway fee ceiling. Defaults to 0.05.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only to resume this exact interrupted deposit after reading its operation.

source_chain.description: Source chain holding the owner's USDC.

name: arc_home_deposit
